canonicalSources: Space roadmap and approved PNG v0.3 / SVG Lab v0.1 design
expectedChanges: Introduce opt-in vanilla JS lighting service without new RAF, input handlers, persistence or direct changes to canonical Engine
Accept existing image RGBA and 0.2 surface/height/emission pixel maps with editable vector geometry and preserve source data
Render four time periods with directional sunlight, window/lantern emission, bounded shadow geometry, safe fallback
Add Postcard Generator 0.2 adapter to derive surface shapes from real building/roof/window/corner data without changing generator code
Cover deterministic PNG/code/SVG adapter lighting equivalence, masks, bounds, non-mutation, legacy shape contracts in Node tests; document limits
ownerDecisions: 2026-11-13: author approved PNG Lab v0.3 as provisionally complete, approved SVG visual results, explicitly instructed integration; Production authorization not given

Map shape contract is sukima-stock material-lightmap 0.2 compatible and keeps sourceRGBA immutable; SVG adapter lives near Postcard Generator and does not alter generator source or rendering of existing pages

plan.rollback: Revert only new optional module, opt-in adapter and tests; existing runtime and works remain byte-identical
outOfScope: Production, release promotion or live town changes
Alter canonical engine/input/RAF/Core or existing game save files
Change existing Postcard Generator authoring/rendering behavior
Scene registry/LAB generated files or any new work published as town content
unverified: Physical iPhone Safari visual behavior and touch experience
Actual performance in production games and maps
plan.problem: PNG and SVG visual studies currently each embed independent lighting math; author wants a single reusable renderer for future pixel, SVG and code-made art
plan.currentContract: Engine 0.3.0 and Codea Lite own single RAF/input/viewport; PNG lab keeps material/height/emission and editable shadow/window/light geometry; Postcard Generator separates geometry from SVG render
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Duplicated lighting formulas can diverge, while generated SVG has structural face data not yet mapped into shared runtime
plan.design: A stateless opt-in UMD/Node lighting module (pure maps and per-pixel light rendering, no DOM owners) with generic geometry map builder and shadow projection; a separate Postcard generator adapter creates that geometry from original buildings
alternativesRejected: Patch the canonical Core draw loop directly
Add a separate game engine, WebGL requirement or shadow-specific RAF
Copy full Postcard renderer into the shared engine
Rewrite original PNG assets or all existing works
plan.migration: None; optional dependency with no new storage key or change to existing saves
plan.compatibility: Existing Engine 0.3.0 and Codea Lite scripts, Postcard Generator generated seeds/exports, town and all work files remain untouched
boundaryCases: No normals/depth on a bitmap: maintain fallback to original
Transparent pixels unchanged and existing input arrays never modified
Geometry partially outside viewport and very large polygon input bounds
Window/lamp shapes at night and sun shadows dawn/noon/dusk
Malformed 0.2 maps, unsupported modes, missing optional shapes and disabled feature
No duplicate global listeners, timers, animation loops or storage mutations
testPlan: Run node --test tests/test-lighting.cjs and node syntax checks
Compare Postcard adapter map against generated SVG geometry for multiple seed/roof/window variants
Inspect branch diff, Scope / Risk / Impact trusted gate results and no changes to forbidden files
Document browser/iPhone physical check as UNVERIFIED until owner tests
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only opt-in code. No production deployment. Merge only if required gates pass and no high-risk blocker.
